title: California Student Data Privacy Agreement - District and Inkwire, Inc. - Chief Systems and Services Officer
official_text: Ratification by the Board of Education of a California Student Data Privacy Agreement by and between District and Inkwire, Inc., San Francisco, CA, prescribing the duties and responsibilities of the latter to protect student data transmitted to it from the District pursuant to the Service Agreement, between the Parties, including compliance with all applicable statutes including the FERPA, PPRA, COPPA, SOPIPA, AB 1584 and other applicable California State laws, all as may be amended from time to time, for the duration of the Service Agreement or so long as Inkwire, Inc., maintains any Student Data of the District, at no cost to the District.
headline: Ratifies Inkwire's promise to protect student data at no cost to the district
summary: The Board is ratifying a student data privacy agreement with Inkwire, Inc. It sets out how Inkwire must protect student information the district shares with it under a separate service agreement, following federal and California privacy laws. It lasts as long as that service agreement or as long as Inkwire holds district student data, and costs the district nothing.
outcome_action: Adopted on the General Consent Report

title: Memorandum of Understanding – Albany Unified School District – Special Education Department
official_text: Approval by the Board of Education of a Memorandum of Understanding (MOU) by and between the Oakland Unified School District (OUSD) and the Albany Unified School District (AUSD), Albany, CA, for the latter to work in coordination with OUSD to ensure that, when necessary, the latter’s students have access to special education programs operated by OUSD when an appropriate program is not available in the pupil’s District of Residence (DOR), with OUSD implementing the educational program provided for in the student’s IEP and cooperating with the DOR, for the period of January 3, 2022, through January 3, 2023, with the OUSD receiving an amount not to exceed $29,085.00.

outcome_action: Adopted on the General Consent Report

title: Amendment, No. 1, Services Agreement - COVID-19 Support – Oakland Public Education Fund – Office of the Chief of Staff

The service period is July 1, 2021 through June 30, 2022.
